description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1]/[50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [Weakness +15% Boost (15s)]/[75% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [Weakness +30% Boost (15s)] to all allies if 1/2/4+ FF14 allies are alive, grants [Attach Holy], [Awoken Knight] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: 50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 50% for the next attack

description.name: Weakness +15% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 15% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: 75% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 75% for the next attack

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Knight
description.text: Knight abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Knight abilities trigger 1 additional time
